summary: Implemented the rich.progress open/wrap_file feature across rich/progress.py, tests/test_progress.py (19 new tests), docs/source/progress.rst, and CHANGELOG.md. The diff is additive only (794 insertions, no deletions) and nothing is committed. I did not run tests, scripts, or repo code, so everything was verified by reading only. Open risks: (1) on Python 3.6, typing.IO's abstract mode/name properties may make _ProgressReader uninstantiable; not verified. (2) The `# type: ignore[return-value, type-var]` on module-level open follows the spec but may be unused under mypy; not verified. (3) No test covers buffering values above 1 being forwarded to the handle.
